name: Local SEO Lesson - Module 5 On-Page SEO for Your Website
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
Local on-page optimization: titles, metas, headings, content, NAP on the site, images, mobile and speed.

# Key points
- Titles: city plus primary keyword near the start, about 50 to 60 characters, unique per page.
- Meta descriptions: city plus a selling point or CTA; they affect clicks, not rankings directly.
- H1 and opening paragraph name the service and city; one page per service or location when they differ; descriptive internal anchors.
- NAP in text in the footer or header and on the contact page, matching GBP; embed a Google Map on the contact page.
- Images: compressed, descriptive file names and alt text.
- Mobile-first indexing: responsive, fast (PageSpeed Insights).

# How this applies to TAG clients
- Exact focus keyphrase in the title/H1 is a TAG rule ([SEO Blog Writing Standards](lib:brain-seo-blog-writing-standards)).
- On Pipeliners and Alphalete, titles, metas, H1 overrides, schema and alts are set through OTTO in [Search Atlas](lib:brain-search-atlas); Summit AZ uses Rank Math (since Sep 2026).
- Never invent claims to make a page feel more local.

- [Local SEO Lesson](lib:brain-local-seo-lesson), [Learning Index](lib:brain-learning-index), [Lesson Takeaways 2026-10-08](lib:brain-lesson-takeaways-2026-10-08)
